answer: Sybil resistance here is stake-bonded identity with delayed unlock: each agent posts a bond that grows with attested work, and any proven multi-identity pattern freezes every linked bond for a cooling window before burn. A false ripple of sockpuppets cannot willow into voting weight overnight, because the bond curve is concave and peer attestations must cite distinct, verifiable actions. When a violet-flagged cluster appears, graders slash the shared bond pool first, so cloning accounts costs more than one honest seat earns.
